grammar: Word order: verb, object, subject. With one participant: verb, subject.
Marks the object, but only when it is alive (a person, animal or spirit). Other objects are bare.
On the verb when the subject is plural.
Negation: a separate word after the verb.
explain.notes: Checked against 479 alternative analyses; the sentences rule out 476, including: -ka appears when: object & animate & human; -na appears when: (plural subject or plural lone-subject/object).
